note: RG.Shoot.Curve.continuous asks for two weighted budgets each at most eps near x, where the display has one combined weighted sum tending to zero; the two are equivalent.

snippet.text:
structure Curve (P : BudgetPoint) (T : ℝ → Rep G n) (X : Set ℝ) : Prop where
  beta : ContinuousOn (fun x => (T x).beta) X
  v : ContinuousOn (fun x => (T x).v) X
  reg : ∀ x∈X, ∀ y∈X,(T x).activities.reg=(T y).activities.reg
  forced : ∀ x∈X, ∀ y∈X,(T x).activities.forced=(T y).activities.forced
  continuous : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ x∈X,
      ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝[X] x, deviation P (T x).activities (T y).activities ε

proof_context.conclusion: Curve requires continuity of beta and v on X, constancy of the regular and forced activities, and that nearby activities deviate by at most eps in the weighted budget sense.
